digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary workflow scheduling
propositions: Bridge cron backstop schedule is changed from */20 minutes to a uniform 40-minute cadence expressed as three cron entries (0 0-23/2, 40 0-23/2, 20 1-23/2) across a 2-hour cycle with test assertions that consecutive fire-time gaps are exactly 40 minutes.

Continuous chain re-dispatch pacing is added by recording pass start epoch and sleeping for elapsed duration (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s elapsed) before dispatching, doubling the inter-invocation period without holding runner slots during the pause.
Canary schedule is changed from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *) and its staleness alert window is doubled from 2 hours to 4 hours.
Jenkinsfile backstop mirrors the three-entry 40-minute cycle; all documentation and comments referring to */20 cadence or hourly canary are updated for truthfulness.

Bridge and canary run frequency reduction halves CI runner contention from this job pair but does not resolve Gerrit Verified-lane starvation (609 workflow_dispatch runs) which is a separate open issue.

Pacing sleep executes within the bridge job and halves dispatch events but does not free runner slots during the pause; turning off RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS via repo Variable would be required to release slots outright.
